title: Trace after restriction on an object with a split pullback cover
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be finite étale [def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], let $F$ be an abelian sheaf on $X_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and let $W\to X$ be a small étale-site object [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Suppose a finite index set $J$ and maps $i_j:D_j\to Y\times_X W$ [def-pc-fibre-product] exhibit that scheme as a coproduct, each $i_j$ is an open and closed immersion [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-closed-immersion], and each composite $D_j\to W$ is an isomorphism. The component on $F(W)$ of restriction followed by trace [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-trace] is $|J|\operatorname{id}_{F(W)}$. No degree, connectedness, nonemptiness, or positivity hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Use upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction and Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app to express the transported restriction component as F of the first pullback projection. For an etale localization g:U→X and a split pullback f′:Y×_X U→U, construct the iterated-pullback comparison and its inverse explicitly by pullback.lift. Check both inverse laws and both projection identities by pullback.hom_ext. Apply properties (1) and (2) of the chosen trace family. Naturality of the localization restriction isomorphism carries the local sum into F. Cancel that isomorphism and the pullback comparison to obtain a sum of restrictions along transported sections.

Each transported section composed with the projection is identity, by the first projection identity of the comparison and pullback.lift_fst. Insert and cancel the inverse-image restriction isomorphism, distribute composition over the finite sum, and use contravariant functoriality to turn each summand into identity. Finset.sum_const gives the cardinality multiple, including an empty index set. Invert the supplied component projections to produce the required sections; localize at g=W.hom and evaluate at the identity object of W.Etale. The localized identity object is canonically isomorphic to W. Naturality of restriction followed by trace, and the inverse laws of this final isomorphism, give the stated component equality.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03SH, characterization (1) and (2) after Definition 03SE; explicit pullback-pasting and finite-sum calculation formalized by H2

theorem finiteEtaleTrace_comp_restriction_app_of_split
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsFinite f] [Etale f]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (W : X.Etale)
    (J : Type u) [Fintype J] (D : J → Scheme.{u})
    (i : ∀ j, D j ⟶ pullback f W.hom)
    (_ : Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk (pullback f W.hom) i)))
    (_ : ∀ j, IsOpenImmersion (i j) ∧ IsClosedImmersion (i j))
    (_ : ∀ j, IsIso (i j ≫ pullback.snd f W.hom)) :
    (finiteEtaleRestriction f F ≫ finiteEtaleTrace f F).hom.app (op W) =
      Fintype.card J • 𝟙 (F.obj.obj (op W))
